_note: LV1 (a)/(b) pre-registration record, 2026-11-26 PC session, written after the EXPLORE study (research/studies/lv1_lowvol.py, bnall 1d formation 2020-01..2023-12) and BEFORE the confirm sample (2024-01+) was looked at. Pass rule (in the study docstring, written before running): a form goes to walk-forward iff explore rank-weighted beta-hedged spread net of funding has pooled SR >= 0.5 AND > 0 in >= 3/4 years AND hedged Q1-Q5 of the same sign; F1 (total vol, top-30 = the live definition) gets one walk-forward with the unchanged 11-09 grid {vol_days: [14,30,60], every_days: [3,7]} iff its explore pooled SR > 0.
_decision: NO walk-forward. F1 pooled SR -0.06 <= 0 fails even its lower re-measurement bar; F2/F3 fail SR >= 0.5 and the quintile-sign clause. Spending a walk-forward on a form whose cost-free explore spread is ~0 would only raise the DSR bar for everything else. strategies.lowvol gets no idio-vol option (explore does not support it). Confirm 2024+ is then looked at once, descriptively, to check the verdict is not an explore-period artefact; it cannot promote anything.
